item.title: Windhoek motorists outraged as cashless parking system sparks confusion and extra costs
item.description: The introduction of a new strictly cashless parking system in the Windhoek city centre on Monday has left motorists outraged. KeyPlot Investment (KPI), a private Namibian parking management company hired by the City of Windhoek, started implementing the system on Tuesday. Motorists say the move has made parking unaffordable and inaccessible for many road users. item.title: Harnessing Law Students to Restore Justice, Dignity, and Constitutional Fidelity in Namibia
item.description: In Namibia today, the justice system is under strain with overcrowded police cells, prolonged pre‑trial detention, and a backlog of court cases that defies the very principles our Constitution seeks to protect.
